subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
course: Literary Elements, Argument Writing & Informational Inquiry
title: Grade 6 English Language Arts: Literary Elements, Argument Writing & Informational Inquiry
overview: Grade 6 English Language Arts cultivates analytical reading of complex literature, rhetorical dissection of informational texts, evidence-based argument composition, and public academic discourse.
competencies: Cite comprehensive textual evidence to analyze central ideas, themes, and author viewpoints.
Evaluate the credibility, reasoning, and rhetorical strategies of diverse informational texts.
Craft well-organized, defensible argument and informative essays with precise citations.
Communicate effectively in collaborative academic presentations and structured seminars.

modules.title: Textual Evidence, Character Dynamics & Plot Turning Points
modules.description: Citing textual evidence to support explicit analysis and inferences, tracing how plot unfolds through character decisions.

topics.title: Citing Textual Evidence & Central Theme Analysis
topics.description: Determining themes and writing objective summaries based strictly on explicit details.

topics.title: Plot Episode Progression & Character Development
topics.description: Analyzing how specific scenes contribute to the development of the plot and character changes.

modules.title: Informational Text Structures & Author's Argument Evaluation
modules.description: Analyzing how key individuals, events, or ideas are introduced and elaborated in informational texts.

topics.title: Elaborating Ideas in Informational Texts
topics.description: Analyzing how authors use examples, anecdotes, and technical definitions to explain concepts.

topics.title: Tracing Claims and Distinguishing Fact from Opinion
topics.description: Evaluating whether an author's argument is supported by valid reasons and credible evidence.

modules.title: Argumentative & Informative Essay Composition
modules.description: Writing organized argumentative essays introducing claims, supporting with evidence, and writing research reports.

topics.title: Argumentative Essay Workshop
topics.description: Developing clear claims, using credible sources, acknowledging opposing claims, and crafting conclusions.

topics.title: Explanatory Research and Source Integration
topics.description: Gathering relevant evidence from multiple print and digital sources, avoiding plagiarism.
